The moment of a lamina $D$ with the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)$ about the $y$-axis is given by

$$
{M}_{y}={∬}_{D}x\,\lambda (x,y)\,\text{d}A.
$$

In our case, $\lambda (x,y)=2x{y}^{2}$ and the plate occupies the region

$$
D={(x,y):0\le x\le 3,\,0\le y\le 2}.
$$

Therefore, the moment is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{y} & ={∬}_{D}x\cdot 2x{y}^{2}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}2{x}^{2}{y}^{2}\,\text{d}A \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{3}{\int }_{0}^{2}2{x}^{2}{y}^{2}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{3}2{x}^{2}{[\frac{1}{3}{y}^{3}]}_{y=0}^{y=2}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{3}2{x}^{2}(\frac{8}{3}-0)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{3}\frac{16}{3}{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[\frac{16{x}^{3}}{9}]}_{x=0}^{x=3} \\  & =\frac{16(3)^{3}}{9}-0 \\  & =48.\end{aligned}
$$
